preconditions.description: The input S is a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S contains only lowercase English letters and '?' characters.
The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value is either -1 or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or all(S[i] == S[-i-1] for i in range(len(S)//2))
postconditions.description: If the return value is not -1, the string S is a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or return_value == sum(abs(ord(S[i]) - ord(S[i+1])) for i in range(len(S)-1))
postconditions.description: If the return value is not -1, it is the sum of the absolute differences of adjacent characters in the palindrome S.
